## Summary

- **Translate all 5 Rocq (.v) files to Lean 4**: Complete 1:1 translations of Definitions, Conversions, Equivalence, Examples, and Lemmas (verified: identical definition counts in all 5 file pairs)
- **Restructure article into `article/` folder**: Split `article.md` into `index.md` + 7 per-section markdown files (all under 1500-line limit). Original `article.md` removed — all content lives in `article/` folder only
- **Include both Rocq and Lean source code in article sections**: Each formal verification section shows both Rocq and Lean implementations side by side
- **Add CI/CD workflow** (`verification.yml`): Automatic compilation verification for both Rocq (Docker `rocq/rocq-prover:9.1`) and Lean (`lake build` with `v4.28.0`), plus file size checks
- **Add file size limit script** (`scripts/check-file-size.mjs`): Enforces 1500-line max for `.v`, `.lean`, `.md` files in `drafts/`
- **Use latest versions**: Rocq 9.1 (Feb 2026 stable), Lean 4.28.0 (Feb 2026 stable)

```
│   │   └── AssociativeNetworkLemmas.v
│   └── lean/
│       ├── lakefile.lean
│       ├── lean-toolchain
│       ├── AssociativeNetworkDefinitions.lean
│       ├── AssociativeNetworkConversions.lean

│       └── AssociativeNetworkLemmas.lean
├── .github/workflows/verification.yml
└── scripts/check-file-size.mjs
```

## Test plan

- [x] All 5 Lean files compile with `lake build` (CI verified)
- [x] All 5 Rocq files compile with `rocq makefile` (CI verified)
- [x] All files under 1500-line limit (CI verified)
- [x] Article Lean code blocks match actual compiled source files
- [x] 1:1 definition count match between Rocq and Lean (22, 14, 4, 47, 4)
- [x] `article.md` removed — no duplicate content
- [x] Latest versions: Rocq 9.1, Lean 4.28.0

Closes #35
